children.text: This vision belonged to two pioneers, Dr. Aysha Al Sayyar and Dr. Nawaf Fawaz, who dreamed of creating more than just a school, they envisioned a place where global minds could blossom within the rich fabric of Emirati values.

From day one, our school has been more than a school. It has been a second home, to students, families, and educators who believe that education is not just about grades, but about character, creativity, and community.

Here, young minds are nurtured, challenged, and inspired. Our students explore science, solve problems, design projects, lead teams, speak up, and give back. From early learners discovering the world to graduates stepping into it, every child at SAIS - Sharjah is part of something bigger. Our commitment to nurturing well-rounded, responsible, and innovative individuals has guided the school’s steady growth and strong reputation throughout the years.

children.text: The Governance Board regularly convenes to ensure curriculum coordination, protocols, processes, and practices remain consistent and cohesive across all SAIS institutions. Over the past three decades, we have prepared thousands of students for success in higher education and beyond. Our graduates have gone on to attend prestigious universities in the UAE and abroad, and many have established themselves as leaders in diverse fields such as medicine, engineering, technology, public services, and education. Our alumni go on to study in the world’s top universities. They become engineers, doctors, designers, thinkers, and leaders. But most importantly, they leave our corridors as confident, compassionate people ready to make a difference.

children.text: What makes SAIS - Sharjah special isn’t just the curriculum or the technology or even the impressive university acceptance letters, it’s the feeling. The feeling of belonging. Of walking into a school where you’re seen, supported, and expected to succeed. SAIS - Sharjah is proud of its past, rooted in purpose, and focused on the future. We are proud to be a school of possibilities. A school that grows with its people and for its people.

As we look toward the future, we remain dedicated to educational excellence, continuous innovation, and the development of compassionate, forward-thinking individuals who are prepared to contribute meaningfully to both local and global communities.
And our story? It’s still being written, by every student who dares to dream, and every teacher who helps them believe they can.

The Cognitive Abilities Test (CAT4) helps us understand how students learn and their academic potential. Students in Grades 3-9 take this assessment upon enrollment to identify their learning styles, enabling teachers to:

•	Adapt teaching approaches and materials

•	Verbal Reasoning - Understanding and reasoning through words
•	Quantitative Reasoning - Using numerical skills for problem-solving
•	Non-verbal Reasoning - Problem-solving using visual information
•	Spatial Ability - Thinking and drawing conclusions in three dimensions

children.text: Our admissions team is here to guide you through each step of the application process and answer any questions you may have. We welcome families who are looking for a school that combines academic excellence, strong values, and meaningful opportunities for personal growth.

Please note that school fees for the upcoming academic year are subject to change in accordance with Article 51 of the Bylaw of Federal Law No. (28) of 1999 Concerning Private Education and applicable regulations.
All tuition fees must be settled on or before the specified due dates as defined in the payment plan.
The registration fee is deducted from tuition fees upon enrollment.
An early payment discount is available for full payment made before the commencement of Term One.
For post-dated cheques (PDC), amounts will be considered paid only after successful clearance and credit to the school’s bank account.
A service charge of AED 500 will be applied for any cheques returned by the bank.
Parents/guardians will be billed for any damage to school property caused by their child.
The registration fee is non-refundable and non-transferable under all circumstances.
School books and uniforms are non-refundable items.
Cash
Current dated cheque
Post-dated cheques
Credit card (Visa or Mastercard)
Wire transfer
Please note:
Current dated or post-dated cheques will not be accepted for initial academic year payments unless submitted at least one month before the academic year commences.
Fees are considered paid only when credited to the school’s bank account.
A student’s registration is considered complete only after the first payment has been cleared, whether made in cash, by credit card, or wire transfer.
For wire transfers, all associated bank charges must be covered by the parent/guardian. Only the net amount received in the school’s account will be credited against outstanding fees.
The school reserves the following rights regarding non-payment of fees:
To send payment reminders via email, written notices, phone calls, SMS, and parent portal notifications to parents/guardians with outstanding payments.
To temporarily suspend students for up to three school days per term (consecutively or intermittently) after issuing three payment default notices.
To withhold the provision of learning resources, participation in extra-curricular activities and field trips, and access to school ICT networks, library, laboratories, and other facilities.
To withhold transfer certificates, grade reports, mark sheets, transcripts, and recommendation letters for any student with outstanding fees.
To pursue appropriate legal action and/or inform relevant authorities to recover outstanding fees.
To claim legal fees and associated costs incurred in the recovery of outstanding fees.
In accordance with the Ministry of Education decree:
1. Parents/guardians must provide 30 days’ advance notice of student withdrawal and submit a formal refund request.
2. Withdrawal prior to the commencement of the academic year:
If initiated by the parent/guardian: The balance of the first term fee paid will be refunded; registration and admission fees remain non-refundable.
If initiated by the school: The amount corresponding to the first term fee paid is refunded, excluding the registration fee.
3. Withdrawal during the school term:
If a student attends any part of the first week or fails to attend without written notification one week before term commencement: The school retains the full registration or re-registration fee.
If a student attends two weeks or less in a term: The school will charge the equivalent of one full month of tuition fees.
If a student attends more than two weeks but less than one month: The school will charge the equivalent of two full months of tuition fees.
If a student attends more than one month in a term: The school will charge the full-term fee.
One month’s fee is calculated as one-tenth of the total annual school fees.

children.text: We have a dedicated space where students engage in hands-on learning experiences that combine engineering, programming, and innovation. Using programmable robotics kits such as LEGO EV3 and Arduino-based systems, students design, build, and code robots to perform tasks, solve challenges, and compete in school and interschool competitions.

The lab promotes critical thinking, collaboration, and creativity, allowing students to explore concepts like automation, sensors, artificial intelligence, and mechanical systems. Through structured lessons and open-ended projects, learners apply their knowledge in real-world contexts, preparing them for future pathways in robotics, technology, and engineering fields.
From elementary to high school, the Robotics Lab fosters curiosity, resilience, and problem-solving, empowering students to become tomorrow's innovators.

heading.title: SGA Ministries & Leadership Structure

children.text: Students participate in a wide array of programs including environmental clubs, public speaking forums, chess clubs, and TED Talks, where they learn to express ideas that inspire change. Performers and artists take the spotlight during SAIS Got Talent, celebrating creativity and individuality across all grade levels.

Athletic teams in basketball and football build discipline and school spirit, while the robotics program, science expos, and leadership forums empower students to solve problems, innovate, and lead with impact.

Whether leading, competing, performing, or inventing, SAIS students are encouraged to pursue their passions and embrace every opportunity. Our student life is not just an extension of learning, it's where voices are heard, visions are shaped, and ventures take flight.

image.alt: SAIS - Sharjah students in their varsity jackets on campus

children.text: In 2025, we introduced the Mini Student Government Association (Mini SGA), a new leadership initiative for students in Grades 5 to 8. The Mini SGA is designed to develop essential skills such as communication, organization, teamwork, and responsibility at an early age. Students have the opportunity to run for positions including a president, a vice president, Ambassadors of Wellbeing, Innovation, Sustainability, Activities, Sports, Culture and Diversity, secretary, treasurer, and class representatives.

Members meet to discuss school improvement ideas, plan student-led activities, support school events, and represent the voices of their peers. This initiative not only encourages active participation in school life but also prepares students for future leadership roles within the SAIS community.

image.alt: SAIS - Sharjah elementary students walking through the school corridor

children.text: Through the Student Government Association (SGA), student leaders take initiative in planning school-wide events, advocating for their peers, and promoting a strong sense of community. Our students proudly represent SAIS on open days in university, local and international competitions, leadership forums, and academic fairs, gaining valuable exposure to real-world experiences. Whether competing in debate tournaments, science expos, or athletic championships, or joining one of our many sports teams, students learn teamwork, resilience, and school pride.
From celebrating cultural heritage during National Day festivities to showcasing talent in interschool competitions, student life thrives with purpose and pride.

children.text: Excellence is more than a goal it is a continuous journey reflected in the accomplishments of our vibrant student body and dedicated staff. Our school takes pride in nurturing learners who excel in academics, sports, leadership, creativity, and innovation.

Throughout the academic year, our students have distinguished themselves in a wide array of local and national competitions, demonstrating critical thinking, communication, and collaborative skills. From mathematics challenges and reading contests to national-level innovation fairs and debate forums, our students consistently represent the school with pride and intellect.

image.alt: Honoring Excellence in Every Journey

children.text: In the sports arena, our teams have earned top rankings in inter-school tournaments, including a remarkable second place in the Canadian University Football Championship and active participation in the AUS Sharakah Sports Festival.
Our chess players have also made notable strides, participating in inter-school chess tournaments that celebrate strategic thinking and mental agility.

Beyond academics and sports, our students shine in cultural, creative, and leadership platforms, whether through SAIS TALKS, entrepreneurship expos, sustainability initiatives, or the widely celebrated “Made in UAE” innovation showcase.

These achievements are a testament to the school's holistic approach to education where curiosity is encouraged, talents are nurtured, and every student is empowered to reach their fullest potential.
SAIS - Sharjah remains committed to building a generation of confident, capable, and compassionate individuals prepared to lead and contribute meaningfully to the world.

children.text: Student safety and wellbeing are at the forefront of our transportation services. All school buses are equipped with live monitoring systems, internal surveillance cameras, and GPS tracking to ensure secure and efficient travel.

image.alt: Student Safety

children.text: To maintain safety and organization, seating assignments follow a structured route-based system. Boarding procedures are designed to minimize student conflict.

Each bus is staffed with a licensed driver and a trained assistant who ensure student supervision, manage attendance, and support younger children. Detailed attendance records are maintained daily, and absences are promptly reported to the school administration.
Additionally, all buses undergo regular cleaning and sanitization to uphold the highest standards of hygiene and safety.
